english.note: Use 雲雀 as the ordinary Cantonese name for the small singing bird, rather than for the other meanings.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese name for the skylark species.

examples.english: The lark singing outside the window really cheers me up in the morning.
examples.traditional: 雲雀喺窗外唱歌，朝早聽到好精神。
examples.jyutping: wan4 zoek3 hai2 coeng1 ngoi6 coeng3 go1 ziu1 zou2 teng1 dou3 hou2 zing1 san4

examples.english: When we went to the countryside, we saw a skylark singing as it flew.
